Uber, Lyft, and similar services

- Only the person named on the receipt can be reimbursed
- Verification of initial departure point required
- Digital receipts are accepted for arrival trip only

- Keep all receipts safe until reimbursement is processed

# The Office of Undergraduate Research and Major Awards

# Undergraduate Research Travel Fellowship
The Office of Undergraduate Research and Major Awards offers the Undergraduate Research
Travel Fellowship to support undergraduate students from the University of Houston
in enhancing their academic development, disseminating their research results, and
increasing the visibility of the institution by supporting undergraduate student travel
at regional, national, and international conferences. The travel funding is intended
for undergraduates presenting the results of their research or creative activities
at meetings for a regional, national, or international audience within their academic
discipline.
**The Undergraduate Research Travel Fellowship application is now closed for the 2024-2025
academic year. Please check back in August for the 2025-2026 URTF application.**
## Funding Offered
Students may apply for up to $500 to cover travel expenses associated with attending
and presenting their research or creative work at a conference.
The Undergraduate Research Travel Fellowship may not cover all expected travel expenses.
Students are strongly encouraged to seek additional funding through research grants,
conference travel award programs, and awards offered by their department

# Travel Grant

Note: Travel funds for the Fall 2025 semester have been exhausted. We are currently accepting travel grant applications for the Spring 2026 semester.

The Virginia Tech Office of Undergraduate Research encourages students to present their research at conferences. OUR travel support program will cover expenses related to presenting at a conference. This rolling review process is designed to assist undergraduate students who have had their research or creative scholarship accepted for presentation at a regional, national or international conference. This program will provide travel funding to students who, without this support, may not be able to attend a conference to present their work. Current undergraduates from any discipline are eligible to apply for travel support.

The office will match funds you secure from other sources (such as your research mentor, department, college, student organization, student government, etc.) up to $750 for domestic travel and $1000 for international travel to support your travel, based on fund availability. Students must apply before they present at a conference. ## The Challenge

News influencers, newsfluencers or news creators – however you label them – are transforming how current events get shared and understood by the public. They build trust and reach with audiences who feel disconnected from traditional journalism and who prefer to consume information on social platforms. title: 2026 Student Challenge with ATCO SpaceLab - Innovation North
text:
2026 Student Challenge with ATCO SpaceLab – Innovation North

# 2026 Student Challenge with ATCO SpaceLab

The 2026 Student Challenge is a Canada-wide student challenge organized by Innovation North in partnership with ATCO SpaceLab. Now in its third year, Innovation North’s annual Student Challenge gives students hands-on experience applying systems thinking to real-world problems. Previous Challenges explored the future of retail and local communities with Walmart Canada, and loneliness and mental wellness at work with BMO.

This year’s Challenge will explore the complex issue of housing—an area shaped by many sectors, stakeholders, and perspectives. Housing sits at the intersection of economic forces, public policy, technology, and community needs, making it a challenge that can’t be solved with simple or one-size-fits-all solutions.

## How It Works

To participate, you’ll need to form a team of 3–5 eligible students. As part of the application process, your team will complete a short screening challenge designed to assess your readiness to engage with complex problems. It’s not about having the “right” answers but instead demonstrating curiosity, openness, and a willingness to think beyond quick ideas.

## Call For Student Scholarship Applications

SOSP 2026, through generous donations from conference sponsors, will offer scholarships to assist students attending the conference. Each scholarship reimburses the SOSP conference registration and may reimburse ground/air travel to/from the conference and lodging expenses during the conference. Due to the high variability in travel costs, awardees are asked for their due diligence in finding reasonably priced fares. Applicants must submit an estimate of these travel costs with the scholarship application.

Scholarship students are expected to assist the conference organizers in some way. For example, scholarship students may be asked to scribe a technical session or help with a town hall at the conference. These services are greatly appreciated, and provide additional networking opportunities with other conference participants. Actual duties will be assigned as the conference nears.

These funds are limited and will be based on a combination of need and merit. Scholarship recipient contact information will be made available to the organizations sponsoring the scholarships.

The Impact of the AnitaB.org Kamala Scholars Program | GHC

# AnitaB.org Kamala Scholars

The AnitaB.org Kamala Scholars Program empowers the next generation of innovators by providing resources, mentorship, and access to Grace Hopper Celebration.

2026 Applications coming soon!

## About the Kamala Scholars Program

The Kamala Scholars Program is a year-long opportunity made possible through the generosity of an anonymous donor, in honor of a family member, and is dedicated to opening doors and creating pathways for 3rd- and 4th-year undergraduate students pursuing technical computing fields. AnitaB.org offers many opportunities to elevate the full diaspora of our community. This particular scholarship is focused exclusively on Black and Latine students, in alignment with the donor’s wishes. Each year, we welcome 100 students into the program.

### Scholars receive:

1

### Travel, Lodging & Transportation

Fully funded travel, lodging, and transportation to attend Grace Hopper Celebration

2

### AnitaB.org Membership

One year of Premium AnitaB.org Membership

3

### Career Coaching Sessions

12 one-on-one career coaching sessions for professional growth

As part of their commitment, selected scholars are required to attend GHC 26 in Anaheim, October 27-30, 2026, participate fully in their coaching sessions, and complete required program surveys.
